name: Roomy
summary: Roomy is a free decorating game in which a player's link in bio is a tiny 3D isometric room. Players furnish the room from a catalogue of furniture, lamps, plants, games and pets, choose its walls, floor, window and lighting, and grow it from a small room to a larger one. Any object in the room can carry a link, such as a YouTube channel on the TV or a music profile on the record player. Anyone who opens the room's link can turn it around, look inside and follow those links, and the owner sees visits, link opens and knocks day by day. Coins for new items are earned from quests and from visitors' free daily tips; they cannot be bought. While the desktop app is open, new items occasionally turn up in the room for free, and the lighting can follow the time of day where the owner lives.
